1660 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not a century exception because 1600 was a leap year, 1700 will not be).  
49 weeks = 49 × 7 = 343 days.  
Plus 3 days = 346 days to subtract.  

06-17-1660 minus 346 days:  
From 06-17 back to 01-01 is 168 days (31+29+31+30+31+17 = 168).  
346 − 168 = 178 days left to go into previous year (1659).  
1659 is not a leap year (not divisible by 4).  
From 12-31 backward: 178 days before 1660-01-01.

Aug 31 → Aug 1 is 31 days (57−31=26)  
July has 31 days: July 31 → July 6 is 26 days earlier (31−26=5 → July 5? Let’s check carefully).
